content.summary: Reference list (items 425–432) focused on acute heart failure: surveys, registries, clinical phenotypes, outcomes, readmission and mortality studies, and commentary pieces from journals including Eur Heart J, Eur J Heart Fail, Circulation, and Prog Cardiovasc Dis.
